cards.ex: The deal seemed completely above board, so we went ahead with it.
cards.exUz: Kelishuv butunlay haloldek tuyuldi, shuning uchun biz uni davom ettirdik.
cards.uzDef: Halol va qonuniy bo'lgan narsa; shaffof.

cards.ex: The company was accused of cooking the books to hide their losses.
cards.exUz: Kompaniya zararlarini yashirish uchun buxgalteriya hisobotlarini soxtalashtirishda ayblangan.

cards.ex: I think he's on the level; I trust him.
cards.exUz: Menimcha, u rostgo'y; men unga ishonaman.

cards.ex: He tends to fudge the truth when talking about his past.
cards.exUz: U o'zining o'tmishi haqida gapirganda, haqiqatni ozgina o'zgartirishga moyil.

cards.ex: That shop tries to rip off tourists by charging double the price.
cards.exUz: Bu do'kon sayyohlarni narxni ikki baravar oshirib aldamoqchi bo'ladi.

cards.ex: The police often turn a blind eye to minor traffic violations.
cards.exUz: Politsiya ko'pincha mayda yo'l harakati qoidabuzarliklariga ko'z yumadi.
cards.uzDef: Noto'g'ri narsani bilib turib e'tibor bermaslik.

cards.ex: He thought he could get away with cheating on the exam.
cards.exUz: U imtihonda aldab jazodan qutulish mumkin deb o'yladi.

cards.ex: He claims to have clean hands in this scandal.
cards.exUz: U bu janjalda beg'ubor qo'llarga ega ekanligini da'vo qilmoqda.
cards.uzDef: Hech qanday noto'g'ri ish qilmagan bo'lish.

cards.ex: The singer accused the radio station of accepting payola.
cards.exUz: Qo'shiqchi radio stantsiyasini pora olishda aybladi.
cards.uzDef: Radio stantsiyalariga pul berib, qo'shiqlarni efirga uzatish.

cards.ex: The movie featured a crooked cop who took bribes from criminals.
cards.exUz: Filmda jinoyatchilardan pora oladigan poraxo'r politsiyachi tasvirlangan.

cards.ex: They bent the rules to help their friend get the job.
cards.exUz: Ular do'stlariga ishga joylashishga yordam berish uchun qoidalarni buzishdi.

cards.ex: The accountant was arrested for embezzling funds from the company.
cards.exUz: Buxgalter kompaniyadan mablag' o'g'irlagani uchun hibsga olindi.

cards.ex: They tried to bribe the official to get the permit approved.
cards.exUz: Ular ruxsatni tasdiqlash uchun amaldorni pora bilan sotib olishga harakat qilishdi.

cards.ex: He was charged with tax evasion and fraud.
cards.exUz: U soliqdan qochish va firibgarlikda ayblangan.

cards.ex: It was an honest mistake; I didn't mean to delete the file.
cards.exUz: Bu halol xato edi; men faylni o'chirishni xohlamagan edim.

cards.ex: Allowing them to stay up late is a slippery slope; soon they'll want to stay up all night.
cards.exUz: Ularga kechgacha uxlashga ruxsat berish sirpanchiq yo'l; tez orada ular butun tunni uxlamaslikni xohlashadi.
cards.uzDef: Kichik noto'g'ri harakatlar kattaroq muammolarga olib kelishi.

cards.ex: He decided to turn informant to reduce his prison sentence.
cards.exUz: U qamoq muddatini qisqartirish uchun xabar beruvchi bo'lishga qaror qildi.

cards.ex: She blew the whistle on the company's illegal activities.
cards.exUz: U kompaniyaning noqonuniy faoliyati haqida xabar berdi.

cards.ex: They had to grease the official's palm to get the contract.
cards.exUz: Ular shartnomani olish uchun amaldorga pora berishlari kerak edi.
cards.uzDef: Kimnidir pora bilan sotib olish (noaniq usulda).

cards.ex: It felt like the election was a rigged game from the start.
cards.exUz: Saylov boshidanoq soxta o'yinga o'xshardi.

cards.ex: I wouldn't get involved in that deal; it sounds a bit shady.
cards.exUz: Men bu kelishuvga aralashmasdim; u biroz shubhali tuyuladi.
cards.uzDef: Ishonchsiz yoki noqonuniy bo'lishi mumkin bo'lgan kelishuv.

cards.ex: He took the fall for his friend's mistake to protect him.
cards.exUz: U do'stini himoya qilish uchun uning xatosi uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga oldi.
cards.uzDef: Boshqaning xatosi uchun javobgarlikni o'z zimmasiga olmoq.

cards.ex: The report was a whitewash designed to protect the company's reputation.
cards.exUz: Hisobot kompaniyaning obro'sini himoya qilish uchun mo'ljallangan yashirish edi.

cards.ex: The builder cut corners to finish the project on time.
cards.exUz: Quruvchi loyihani o'z vaqtida tugatish uchun arzonlashtirdi.

cards.ex: You can trust him; he's completely on the up-and-up.
cards.exUz: Siz unga ishonishingiz mumkin; u butunlay halol.
cards.uzDef: Halol va qonuniy yo'l bilan ish yuritish.

cards.ex: He double-crossed his partners and ran off with the money.
cards.exUz: U sheriklariga xiyonat qildi va pul bilan qochib ketdi.

cards.ex: They paid him under the table so they wouldn't have to pay taxes.
cards.exUz: Ular soliq to'lamaslik uchun unga yashirincha pul to'lashdi.

cards.ex: He tried to pull a fast one on me, but I saw right through it.
cards.exUz: U meni aldashga harakat qildi, lekin men buni darhol angladim.

cards.ex: Just keep your nose clean and stay out of trouble.
cards.exUz: Faqat o'zingni tiy va muammolardan uzoqroq bo'l.

cards.ex: I always try to give my customers a square deal.
cards.exUz: Men har doim mijozlarimga adolatli kelishuv berishga harakat qilaman.
